name: open-science-pillars
description: Earth science skills, steward-signed knowledge and deterministic verification for Claude Code and Claude Cowork, organized by sphere.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Foundation: earth science data formats, statistics, uncertainty quantification, cartography, quality control, reproducibility, analysis review.

plugins.name: ocean-science
plugins.description: Physical oceanography: ECCO state estimate, SWOT SSH, meridional transport, budget closure, water masses.

plugins.name: hydrology
plugins.description: Hydrology: SWOT river and lake products, GRACE-FO groundwater, USGS NWIS streamflow, SMAP soil moisture.

plugins.name: atmospheric-physics
plugins.description: Atmospheric physics: run instructions for the attested radiation budget computations signed in the ASDC bundle, the CERES EBAF energy budget closure and the cloud radiative effect at the top of the atmosphere.

plugins.name: land-ice
plugins.description: Land ice: run instructions for the attested ice sheet mass balance computations signed in the NSIDC bundle, the gravimetry against altimetry closure and the input-output balance through a flux gate set.

plugins.name: nasa-daac-knowledge
plugins.description: Provider knowledge bundles from NASA DAACs, one per archive: PO.DAAC (ECCO, SWOT, GRACE-FO, MUR, NASA-SSH, RAPID), ASDC (CERES radiation budget), NSIDC (land ice and sea ice), GES DISC (MERRA-2, AIRS, OMI, solar-induced fluorescence), LP DAAC (land surface), OB.DAAC (ocean color), ORNL DAAC (surface meteorology and biogeochemistry) and the ESDIS metadata requirements. Facts about data, signed by their stewards; no skills. Installed automatically as a dependency of the domain capabilities.
